annotations.title: Rename a server / set its backup schedule

description: Change a server's title, hostname and/or simple-backup schedule. Only these reversible fields are exposed — no resizing or plan change (billing) and no firewall toggle. simple_backup is `HHMM,daily|dailies|weeklies|monthlies` (UTC time) or `no` to disable. UpCloud: PUT /1.3/server/{uuid}.

simple_backup.description: e.g. 0430,dailies — or `no` to turn simple backups off.

name: upcloud_modify_server
